description: Bulk upload and download are multipart, which the REST protocol does not encode or decode: POST /files/bulk-upload takes multipart/form-data with `files[i].path` and `files[i].file` fields (the spec declares no input), and POST /files/bulk-download answers multipart/form-data with one `file` part per path and an `error` part (JSON) per failed path. The generated operations sent an empty body and decoded the multipart reply as JSON. Remove them; `uploadFiles` and `downloadFiles` in src/toolbox.ts implement both, checked live 2026-11-04.
